Lexicon import reads a project's glossary into labels, so search answers
to the words people use.

Usage:
  agent index lexicon [flags]
  agent index lexicon [command]

Examples:
  agent index lexicon import docs/lexicon.jsonl

Available Commands:
  import      Import a JSONL glossary: lay phrasings, canonical names, provenance

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for lexicon

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)

Use "agent index lexicon [command] --help" for more information about a command.
